newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica may launch digital TV in March.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica may launch digital TV in March.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica de Espana Chairman Juan Villalonga said on Thursday that the digital TV group Telefonica leads could have its platform up and running in March.
"In the month of March (the digital platform) could be working," Villalonga told Spanish radio.
He added that the group will invest some 10 billion pesetas in the project in 1997.

The digital platform, comprised of Telefonica, Radio Television of Spain (RTVE), Mexican group Televisa and other regional channels and editorial groups, will compete with the project of Canal Satelite, which joins Promotora de Informaciones, S.A. (Prisa), Canal Plus and, as of Wednesday, television channel Antena 3.
